Downtown Corry is driving visitors to its shops with a unique event Friday night.

The annual Bigfoot Bash has returned; it's part of the Downtown Corry Business Association's "First Friday" events, advocating for people to shop local and to bring some life to their shopping corridor.

There are plenty of bigfoot-themed booths and merchandise for people to check out along with some local bigfoot enthusiasts.

The event is also known for its chili cooking contest.

"It's not just me that's involved in the planning, there are several people that all pull everything together and it really works out really well," said Nancy DeMauri, treasurer of the Downtown Corry Business Association.

Bigfoot Bash continues until 9 p.m. on November 6, and shops will be open late.
